steps.title: Factor Lab — per-horizon evidence chip strip
steps.narration: The Factor Lab's evidence column now shows whether a factor's certified edge holds up at every holding period — 1, 5, 10, 20, and 60 trading days — as a compact row of five chips. The column header was updated to 'Evidence (D10 · per horizon)' to reflect this wider coverage.
steps.point_out: Each factor row shows five chips. The vcp_contraction row has two lit 'Proven' chips at 20d and 60d; shorter horizons show 'Not yet proven'. The column header no longer reads '20d'.

steps.title: Click the 60d 'Proven' chip — deep-link to the certified claim
steps.narration: The new 60-day chip on vcp_contraction is a live hyperlink. Clicking it takes you straight to the certified 60-day claim on the Evidence page.
steps.point_out: The browser navigates to /evidence with the h60 anchor active, landing on the vcp_contraction 60-day row showing +8.91% out-of-sample edge.

steps.title: Evidence page — new 60-day certified claim row
steps.narration: The Evidence ledger now holds five certified claims. The newest entry is vcp_contraction at the 60-day holding period — it cleared the pre-registered significance bar with a +8.91% holdout edge versus the SPY benchmark and a 'Pending' forward-walk score that will update as live trades accumulate.
steps.point_out: The fifth row's subtitle reads '60-day hold', its status badge shows PASS, and the forward-walk field reads 'Pending — monitored as new data matures'.

steps.title: Click 'Backs: Research factor lab →' — return from evidence to Factor Lab
steps.narration: Every certified claim that originates from the Factor Lab includes a link back to it, so you can immediately see the full per-horizon picture for that factor without navigating manually.
steps.point_out: Clicking 'Backs: Research factor lab →' on the 60-day row returns to the Factor Lab page, where the chip strip for vcp_contraction is visible.

steps.title: Prior evidence rows unchanged — ledger integrity confirmed
steps.narration: The four earlier certified claims are intact and unmodified — leadership score, breakout watch, moving-average stack, and vcp_contraction at the 20-day horizon all retain their original statuses and figures.
steps.point_out: Rows 1 through 4 show the same PASS and FAIL statuses as before. The vcp_contraction 20-day row's subtitle contains no mention of '60-day'.

steps.title: Factor Lab — both proven horizons for vcp_contraction
steps.narration: On the Factor Lab, vcp_contraction now shows two independently lit 'Proven' chips — one for the 20-day horizon and one for the 60-day horizon — each linking to its own evidence anchor. Factors with no certified claims still show 'Not yet proven' on all five chips.
steps.point_out: The vcp_contraction row shows 'Proven' at 20d and 60d and 'Not yet proven' at 1d, 5d, and 10d. Each 'Proven' chip points to a different evidence anchor URL.
